old.stated: No per-object size cap is stated on the pricing, class or bucket pages; in the cold and ice classes an object smaller than 128 KB is billed as 128 KB
old.notes: a bucket created in the console can be given a maximum volume; buckets created through the API are unlimited in volume

new.stated: A single object is limited to 5 TB; one request uploads at most 5 GB and larger objects need multipart upload; in the cold and ice classes an object smaller than 128 KB is billed as 128 KB
new.notes: the 5 TB object cap and the 5 GB per-request limit are tenant limits that cannot be raised; the storage volume itself is unlimited by default; a bucket created in the console can be given a maximum volume, buckets created through the API are unlimited in volume

evidence.proved: the vendor's limits table states a maximum object size of 5 TB

reason: the limitations page states a per-object cap, so the previous value that no cap is stated is wrong

evidence.proved: the size-limitations FAQ states the same 5 TB cap on one object
a bucket's maximum volume can only be set in the console, not through the API
evidence.quote: При создании бакета через API ограничить его размер нельзя.

evidence.proved: 15 GB of standard-class storage, 100 000 write operations, 1 000 000 read operations and the first 10 TB of traffic each month are unchanged
